title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-16
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard recording of a high‑energy early‑68 show with standout Alligator > Caution, tight Dark Star and powerful The Other One, despite a few minor cuts.
ai_review.review: The concert captures the Dead at a peak of exploratory energy – highlights like the Alligator → Caution sequence, an immaculate China Cat, and a tight Dark Star keep the momentum rolling. Charlie Miller’s soundboard source is generally clear and well‑balanced, though listeners note a vicious cut in The Other One and some brief clipping on Morning Dew. Overall the performance feels “smoking” and the recording is more than listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 5‑star, praising both musical intensity and clear soundboard quality; only minor technical glitches are mentioned, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clear with excellent image; occasional vicious cut in The Other One, brief clipping of Morning Dew, minor distortion in spots, and a need for slight pitch correction on some tracks.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, flowing set with tight transitions; first recorded drum segue between Cryptical and The Other One adds excitement.

band_member_comments.Drums: Positive note on the drum segue between Cryptical and The Other One and praise for keeping tracks unsegmented.
